description: Vesting the land and the constructions of the University College, Kinniya in the Trincomalee district with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2017-06-20 to construct the University College, Kinniya in the Upparuwatta land in extent of 12 acres belonging to the Land Reform Commission in the Upparu Grama Niladhari Division of the Divisional Secretariat Division of Kinniya in the Trincomalee District. An amount of Rs.25.45 million has been spent on the constructions carried out for the college, as of now. Due to the circumstances that have arisen subsequently, the University of Vocational Technology (UNIVOTEC) has decided not to maintain the university college on that land as planned. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, to halt the further construction activities of the University College, Kinniya and to vest the land allocated for the University College and its constructions with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism for the implementation of a project in the tourism sector, as proposed at the Trincomalee District Coordinating Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.
